_comment: The load order, defined once. scripts/build.mjs reads this file and writes
the manifest's content_scripts and the <script> tags of the popup and the
Paths are relative to src/. These are classic scripts sharing one global,
BR, so a file must come after anything it reads at load time.
core     shared by every page, in this order
modules  folders whose files are picked up automatically, sorted by name.
Dropping a file into src/filters/ and running `npm run build` is
the whole procedure for adding a filter. The same goes for
skip/, badges/ and lists/. Display order comes from each module's
own `order` field, never from the file name.
pages    what each page loads after core and the modules
